label: Goal
help: One-shot goal seeded as the first user message.

label: Backend
help: LLM backend. Shells out to the authenticated Claude Code CLI ('claude') or the OpenAI Codex CLI ('codex'). With 'codex', pass a Codex --model or omit it.

label: Execution mode
help: Execution mode: c=orchestrated (DEFAULT) — a senior-pentester orchestrator dispatches concurrent pentester/validator subagents; a=single agent. Tool calls prompt for approval unless you pass --auto-approve/--yolo (use --yolo for unattended runs).

label: Swarm size
help: Top-level collaborating orchestrators (mode c only). Size 1 preserves legacy mode c.

label: Auto approve
help: Auto-approve tools at this risk class. Repeatable.

label: Yolo
help: Auto-approve safe + active tool calls. Does NOT cover exploit (use --auto-approve exploit --i-understand) or destructive (always prompts).

label: I understand
help: Required together with auto-approve=exploit.

label: Allow host exec
help: Allow code/binary tools (python_exec, sqlmap, nmap, …) to be AUTO-APPROVED while running on the host. Off by default: without it, host-executing tools always prompt unless sandboxed with --container.

label: Scope host
help: In-scope host for web_fetch (repeatable).

label: Max turns
help: Orchestrator turn budget. It is told its turns-remaining and stops opening new attack ideas as the budget runs out.

label: Validator max turns
help: Validator investigation steps (its own turn budget, separate from --max-turns).

label: Validator claude max turns
help: claude's INTERNAL per-call --max-turns for the Validator (NOT its investigation budget — that's --validator-max-turns). Keep 1: we drive the loop, and a higher value lets the model drift into a native tool call.

label: Llm timeout
help: Per-call LLM backend wall-clock timeout (seconds), shared by the orchestrator AND the pentester/validator subagents (one value for all). Raise it for heavy iterative exploitation / large-context turns.

label: Pentester max turns
help: Per-subagent turn budget for pentesters, independent of --max-turns.

label: Subagent deadline
help: Hard wall-clock ceiling (seconds) for ONE subagent's whole run, checked between turns. --llm-timeout only bounds a single backend call.

label: Max subagents
help: Max CONCURRENT subagents in orchestrated mode (c) — how many run at once.

label: Max total subagents
help: Hard cap on the TOTAL subagents (pentesters + validators) dispatched over the whole run (orchestrated mode c). 0 = unlimited. Cost-control knob.

label: Container
help: Run tool calls inside the Docker sandbox (image: zero-sandbox). ON by default (secure). Falls back to host execution if Docker is unavailable; --no-container forces host execution.

label: Container image
help: Sandbox image tag.

label: Host network
help: Run the sandbox on the host network (needed for Burp on 127.0.0.1).

label: Session resume
help: Keep one persistent `claude` session per actor and send only each new turn via --resume (claude holds + caches the history) instead of re-shipping the whole transcript every call. Big token saver; claude-backend only.

label: Burp dir
help: Host directory mounted ro at /work/burp inside the sandbox.

label: Files root
help: Root folder the read-only fs tools (list_dir/grep/read_file) are jailed to; resolved against cwd, created if missing, mounted at /zero_files in the sandbox.

label: Container cpus
help: CPU cap for the sandbox.

label: Container memory
help: Memory cap for the sandbox.

label: Remote all tools
help: Proxy EVERY tool through the sandbox (not just python_exec). ON by default so binary tools (sqlmap, nmap, …) are sandboxed too.

label: Rate limit
help: Per-host rate cap, '<int>/sec' or '<int>/min'. Set to '0/sec' to disable.

label: Thought display
help: How much of the agent's reasoning shows in the chat: condensed (one line), full, or off. The complete thought is always kept in thinking.log.

label: Model
help: Model for every LLM call (orchestrator + subagents + validators). For Claude, use an alias ('opus', 'sonnet') or full id; 'claude-opus-5[1m]' is Opus 5 with the 1M-context window. Codex ignores this Claude default and uses its configured default model unless you pass a Codex model id. Pass '' to use the selected backend's account default.

label: Context window
help: Context-window size for the UI's per-agent 'ctx used/window (%)' display. Default: resolved per backend at startup — Codex reads its real model window (~272k) at runtime; Claude infers 1M for a '[1m]' model, else 200k.

label: Llm log
help: Trace the FULL model I/O (argv + system prompt + stdin in, stdout/stderr out) to one file per agent under ./.pentest/llm/<actor>.log. ON by default; pass --no-llm-log to disable. ($ZERO_LLM_LOG_DIR overrides the location.)

label: Ralph
help: Ralph mode: an analyzer/analyzer_validator build a PRD of pentest tasks, then zero loops bounded orchestrated passes over it (each works the top-priority task, records progress, snapshots+resets .pentest/). Wraps mode c. Run with --yolo (and --auto-approve exploit --i-understand for unattended exploitation).

label: Ralph iterations
help: Ralph: number of loop iterations (stops early when all PRD tasks complete). With --ralph-resume these are ADDITIONAL iterations on top of the prior run.

label: Ralph resume
help: Ralph: resume the prior run from ./.ralph/ — load the existing prd.json (keeping completed/pending task state) instead of re-planning, skip the PRD discussion + approval, and continue iteration numbering from the last backup. Confirmed findings and progress.txt already persist.

label: Ralph approve prd
help: Ralph: pause for operator approval of the PRD after the analyzer↔validator discussion, before the loop. The loop iterations always run unattended.

label: Ralph discussion rounds
help: Ralph: max analyzer↔analyzer_validator review rounds before the PRD is accepted as-is (reused for both the epic and task phases).

label: Ralph epics
help: Ralph: two-phase planning — first agree a set of EPICS that partition the attack surface, then decompose each into atomic tasks (every epic gets >=1 task, checked by the validator). --no-ralph-epics uses single-phase task planning.

label: Analyzer validator max turns
help: Ralph: turn budget for the analyzer_validator (PRD review + completion check).
